description: Diagnostics for runner-only failures. Today a blocked source records only 'HTTP 403' (src/http.js once() cancels the body of every >= 400 response; runSource stores errorClass(err)). Add a bounded `detail` string (status evidence: server, cf-ray, cf-mitigated, content-type, location headers + first 300 chars of the tag-stripped body) to the per-source result, meta.json, the Actions log line and the CLI table; add scripts/probe-runner.mjs that prints a header-variant matrix for the 7 Cloudflare-403 URLs and the 6 YouTube channels; add a workflow_dispatch `probe` input to .github/workflows/refresh.yml that runs it. Then push, run on the runner with -f probe=true, and record what the runner actually sees. Plan items 1-4 in .agents/tasks/ahead-build/runner-fix-plan.md (decisions D1, D6). `error` stays the short class because src/schema.js caps it at 120 chars and app.js renders it.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/ahead-build/task-runner-fix/context.json and .agents/tasks/ahead-build/runner-fix-plan.md (sections 'Evidence', 'Decisions', items 1-4). Then git pull --rebase origin main (origin is a data commit ahead) and run npm test once to confirm 177 pass.

src/http.js: add readSnippet(res, maxBytes = 4096) that reads res.body chunks until >= maxBytes or EOF, cancels the reader, decodes UTF-8 and returns '' on any error (works with the Response objects tests build via new Response(body, { status, headers })). Give HttpError an optional 4th constructor argument `detail` stored as this.detail only when provided. In once(): for status >= 400 build detail = { server, cfRay, cfMitigated, contentType, location, body } from res.headers.get('server'|'cf-ray'|'cf-mitigated'|'content-type'|'location') (each value String(v).slice(0, 80); omit absent keys) plus body = snippet.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 300) (omit when empty), then throw new HttpError(status, current, parseRetryAfter(...), detail). On the redirect-exhausted branch pass { location, server } as detail. Export formatDetail(detail) -> single line of key=value pairs joined by '; ' (body rendered as body="..."), control characters [\x00-\x1f\x7f] removed, .slice(0, 400), '' when detail is empty/undefined. Never include request headers or the token.

src/pipeline.js runSource(): in the catch block, after result.error, set result.detail = formatDetail(err.detail) when it is non-empty and change the warn to logger.warn(`${source.id}: ${result.error}${result.detail ? ` [${result.detail}]` : ''}`) (keep exactly 3 console.* uses in pipeline.js: tests/pipeline.test.js counts them). In run()'s per-source accounting, add `if (typeof r.detail === 'string' && r.detail) entry.detail = r.detail;` next to the note/error lines so it reaches meta.sources[id].
src/parsers/arxiv.js: in the primary-and-fallback-both-failed return, add detail from formatDetail(fallbackError.detail) when non-empty (import formatDetail from '../http.js').

src/schema.js validateMeta: after the `error` check add `if ('detail' in s && !(isNonEmptyString(s.detail) && s.detail.length <= 400 && !/[\n\r]/.test(s.detail))) sfail(`${sp}.detail`, 'must be a single line of at most 400 chars');`.
scripts/fetch.mjs printTable(): after the row loop, for every row with r.detail print `  ${r.id}: ${r.detail}` (before the summary line).

tests/helpers.js fixtureFetch overrides: support an optional `headers` object on an override, merged into the Response headers (keep existing status/body/contentType/throw behaviour). tests/http.test.js: add a test building a 403 Response with headers { server: 'cloudflare', 'cf-ray': 'abc123-BOM', 'cf-mitigated': 'challenge', 'content-type': 'text/html' } and a ~2 KB HTML body ('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Just a moment...</title></head><body>' + padding); assert errorClass(err) === 'HTTP 403', err.detail.server === 'cloudflare', err.detail.cfMitigated === 'challenge', err.detail.body has no '<' and length <= 300, formatDetail(err.detail) has no newline, length <= 400 and matches /server=cloudflare; cf-ray=abc123-BOM/; a 404 Response with empty body yields no `body` key and formatDetail still mentions the status-independent headers that exist (or '' when none). tests/pipeline.test.js: add a test using runFixture({ onlySourceIds: ['importai'], dryRun: true, overrides: { [urlOf('importai')]: { status: 403, body: '<html><body>Just a moment...</body></html>', contentType: 'text/html', headers: { server: 'cloudflare', 'cf-ray': 'abc-BOM' } } } }) asserting sourceResults[0].error === 'HTTP 403' and /server=cloudflare/.test(sourceResults[0].detail); and a validateMeta negative test: a copy of a valid meta whose first source gets detail of 401 'x' characters throws SchemaError mentioning '.detail'.
